title: Pisces saw one snowflake. Sobbing.
caption: Pisces saw one snowflake and sobbed, for the third time today. That isn't too much. It's how you love. Bring that soft heart into winter and feel it all, out loud. Send this to the Pisces who cries at the first snow.
